title: 6 Best Goodcall Alternatives in 2026
summary: Six Goodcall alternatives compared for 2026. Goodcall runs $79 to $249 per agent per month and integrates only through Zapier.
body_markdown:
*Written by Punn Kam, ex-Google AI engineer and Y Combinator repeat founder. He is the co-founder of Conduit, an AI agent platform built for hospitality, serving 300+ hospitality brands in 140+ languages. Last updated September 11, 2026.*


Goodcall is an AI phone agent for local service businesses, priced at $79, $129, and $249 per agent per month, or $66, $108, and $208 annually, with $0.50 per customer above the plan limit. It is built for salons, SMBs, and BPO, and it connects to other systems through Zapier. If your callers have reservations, check whether that integration gives the agent access to the booking during a call.


## What is Goodcall?


Goodcall uses AI agents to answer inbound customer calls. Its published solutions target salons, local service businesses, business process outsourcing, appointment scheduling, and answering services.


Goodcall emphasises quick setup, which suits a small salon that needs help answering calls.


Integration runs through Zapier. Goodcall's own FAQ frames it as connecting your agent to your CRM of choice using Zapier, and names no specific platforms beyond that.


## What does Goodcall cost?


Per agent per month: Starter $79, Growth $129 (marked most popular), Scale $249, and Enterprise on request. Annual billing takes 15% off, landing at $66, $108, and $208. Overage is $0.50 per customer above monthly limits that run from 100 to 500 depending on tier.


Estimate how many agents and customers you will need each month. Those determine the bill; your property count does not.


## Why do people look for a Goodcall alternative?


Cost is one reason. Goodcall's $79 starting price is roughly four times Quo's $19 entry price and twice RingCentral's $39 AI Receptionist add-on. Compare the allowances and templates as well as the headline price.


Integration is another. Goodcall names Zapier as its integration path, but no PMS connection. For guest calls, ask for a demonstration of the agent reading a live reservation and updating it before the call ends.


A hotel guest may need help with a specific reservation, property, or access code. Check that the agent can use those details, along with the guest's conversation history.


## Which Goodcall alternatives are worth comparing?


These products charge by agent, user, property unit, or call. Use your expected volume to compare the monthly cost.

### Quo, formerly OpenPhone


Quo starts at $19 per user per month, with the Sona agent answering 24/7. It is worth comparing if your team needs a shared business number.


### RingCentral AI Receptionist


$39 as an add-on or $49 standalone with 100 minutes included, and it works with any phone system. Cheaper than Goodcall and backed by a much larger product if you outgrow it.


### Dialpad


Conversation-based pricing rather than per agent, which suits businesses where volume varies. Dialpad AI Agent is described as autonomous across voice and digital.


### Smith.ai


Smith.ai charges per call and includes live-staffed agents on every plan, making it an option for teams that want human receptionists.


### Conduit


We build Conduit for hospitality teams that need an agent to read and update a reservation during a call. Pricing starts at $18 per property unit per month. The same agent handles voice and text, with write-back across connected PMSes. We report 70-90% automation across the platform, with Cash Flow Street at 96%. For a salon, clinic, or trades business, Goodcall is the more relevant product.


## Who should stay on Goodcall?


Goodcall suits salons, appointment-driven small businesses, and BPO operations whose calls fit its templates. Compare the per-agent cost with the staff time you expect it to save.


Before switching, test the calls Goodcall struggles with and ask whether an alternative can complete them using your business data.


If your callers are hotel guests,[best AI receptionist software for independent hotels](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/best-ai-receptionist-software-independent-hotels) compares options for that workflow.


## FAQ


### How much does Goodcall cost?


$79, $129, and $249 per agent per month for Starter, Growth, and Scale, or $66, $108, and $208 on annual billing, with $0.50 per customer above monthly limits of 100 to 500 depending on tier.


### Does Goodcall integrate with a PMS?


Goodcall names Zapier as its integration path but does not name a property management system. Ask it to demonstrate the reservation reads and updates you need during a live call.


### What is a cheaper alternative to Goodcall?


Quo at $19 per user per month and RingCentral's AI Receptionist at $39 both undercut it substantially while still answering calls autonomously.


### Is Goodcall good for hotels or vacation rentals?


It is built for salons, local service businesses, and BPO. If you need it to act on a booking, verify that workflow directly; its published integration description names Zapier but no PMS.


### Goodcall or Smith.ai?


Goodcall if you want AI at a predictable per-agent price. Smith.ai if you want trained human receptionists and your call volume is low enough that per-call pricing works.
